# Notifications

The signed-in user's in-app notification inbox and personal notification preferences. Session tokens only.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/notifications`](#get-v1notifications) | List the signed-in user's notification inbox |
| POST | [`/v1/notifications/{id}/read`](#post-v1notificationsidread) | Mark an owned notification read |
| GET | [`/v1/me/notifications`](#get-v1menotifications) | List the signed-in user's notification preferences |
| PUT | [`/v1/me/notifications`](#put-v1menotifications) | Set one signed-in user's notification preference |

## GET /v1/notifications

**List the signed-in user's notification inbox**

Operation ID: `listInAppNotifications`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Explicit workspace and environment headers required. Only the current user's customer notifications are returned; legacy notifications with no environment are excluded.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `50` | Constraints: minimum `1`, maximum `200`. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no |  | Opaque cursor returned by the previous page for this collection and workspace. Constraints: maxLength `2048`. |
| `unread` | query | boolean | no | `false` |  |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Notification page. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [InAppNotification](schemas.md#inappnotification) | yes |  |  |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |  |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/notifications" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

## POST /v1/notifications/{id}/read

**Mark an owned notification read**

Operation ID: `markNotificationRead`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Read timestamp is stable on repeat requests. Other users, workspaces, environments and admin notifications return 404.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `id` | path | integer (int64) | yes |  | Constraints: minimum `1`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Updated notification. | `application/json`: [InAppNotification](schemas.md#inappnotification) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/notifications/398/read" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "id": 398,
  "user_id": "f34f08b1-4614-4b20-9bfb-d35c519c7a50",
  "admin_user_id": null,
  "workspace_id": "45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4",
  "event": "sender_id.requested",
  "title": "Sender ID requested",
  "body": "Your sender ID request was received and is awaiting review.",
  "read_at": "2026-09-24T07:40:31.671372+03:00",
  "created_at": "2026-09-24T07:40:27.568666+03:00"
}
```

## GET /v1/me/notifications

**List the signed-in user's notification preferences**

Operation ID: `listMyNotificationPreferences`. Tag: _none in contract_.

Returns preferences across all non-deleted workspaces the signed-in user belongs to. No selected workspace or environment header is required.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | User notification preferences. | `application/json`: array of [NotificationPreference](schemas.md#notificationpreference) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/me/notifications" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
[]
```

## PUT /v1/me/notifications

**Set one signed-in user's notification preference**

Operation ID: `putMyNotificationPreference`. Tag: _none in contract_.

The user must be an active member of the given workspace. User preferences override workspace defaults.

**Auth:** Session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

Schema: [NotificationPreference](schemas.md#notificationpreference).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `event` | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `128`. |
| `channel` | string | yes |  | One of: `email`, `sms`, `in_app`, `slack`. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |  |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Updated user notification preference. | `application/json`: [NotificationPreference](schemas.md#notificationpreference) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `503` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -s -X PUT "$OPENSMS_API/v1/me/notifications" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "workspace_id": "45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4",
  "event": "wallet.low_balance",
  "channel": "email",
  "enabled": false
}'
```

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "workspace_id": "45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4",
  "event": "wallet.low_balance",
  "channel": "email",
  "enabled": false
}
```
